checks.why: the report-only loop must not alter a single byte of any content or data record
a successful fetch proves a page responded, never that a person read it and agreed, so no composed change may move a verification date
a confirmation produces a PROPOSED evidence row for a person to accept; recording one automatically is the same check-date failure wearing a different field name
every proposed change must cite the fetched artifact it came from, by digest
an escalation without a specific question and a default is a notification, and notifications are what a review queue dies of
the only outbound traffic permitted is a GET of a URL a record already cites
unreachable and blocked are source-health facts, never verdicts about a claim
this publication carries no prices, and a rate finding must escalate without one riding along
